headline: Murasu Crosses Andhra Coast Near Ongole
deck: The cyclone brought gusts up to 120 kmph; early reports describe uprooted trees, damaged power poles, wrecked boats and heavy rain.
body: Severe Cyclonic Storm Murasu crossed the south Andhra Pradesh coast near Ongole between 3:30 a.m. and 5:30 a.m. on Tuesday, the India Meteorological Department said, with winds reaching 120 kmph. The Hindu’s morning digest said the landfall process had begun near Ongole at 1 a.m. [E1] [E2]
The New Indian Express reported that the storm uprooted thousands of trees, damaged hundreds of electric poles, wrecked fishing boats and inundated several areas of coastal Andhra Pradesh. [E3]
Kothapatnam in Prakasam district recorded 16.4 cm of rain between 8:30 a.m. Monday and 5 a.m. Tuesday, the highest total in the state during that period, the paper reported. [E4]

evidence_box.fragment: The cyclone crossed the coast between Nellore and Narsapur, close to Ongole in Prakasam district, between 3.30 am and 5.30 am, with wind speeds of 100–110 kmph and gusts reaching 120 kmph, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) said.
